Upper Text: [On Play][When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon can't suspend. Then, if this Digimon has no digivolution cards, you may place 1 [Yuuko Kamishiro] from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 [Yuuko Kamishiro] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
